svg.aria-label: The crew in the agents panel: the astronaut (crab-fable, Fable at high effort), the detective (crab-heavy, Opus at xhigh), the engineer (crab-careful, Opus at high), the chef (crab-medium, Opus at medium), the racer (crab-light, Sonnet at low), the pirate (Explore), the architect (Plan) and the handyman in overalls (any other agent)
